t: You're at the site of St Mary's Church in Bromley St Leonard's, in Bromley-by-Bow. It was a Church of England parish church, and it is no longer in use. Bromley St Leonard's was split from Stepney parish in 1536, and the church reused the priory church of St Leonard's, a Benedictine nunnery that had just been dissolved. It held significant monumental sculpture. William Benson is buried here. He was an amateur architect and Whig politician, and in 1718 he arranged to displace Sir Christopher Wren as Surveyor of the King's Works, though his time in the post was not a success.
